articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Native Multimodal Reasoning and Extended Context
articles.summary: OpenAI officially released GPT-5 in mid-May 2026, featuring natively fused vision, audio, and text reasoning in a single architecture rather than stitched adapter modules. The model demonstrates significant improvements in long-horizon planning tasks and supports a 1M-token effective context window, raising the bar for enterprise agentic workflows.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves State-of-the-Art on SWE-Bench and ARC-AGI-2
articles.summary: DeepMind announced Gemini Ultra 2, which topped both the SWE-Bench Verified and ARC-AGI-2 benchmarks, demonstrating strong generalization in software engineering tasks and novel abstract reasoning. The model introduces a mixture-of-experts architecture with dynamic routing that significantly reduces inference cost per token compared to its predecessor.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Claude Tool-Use Orchestration Framework for Autonomous Agents
articles.summary: Anthropic released a new orchestration layer for Claude that enables persistent, multi-step tool-use agents with built-in sandboxing, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and audit logging. The framework targets enterprise deployments where compliance and controllability are critical, supporting up to 200 sequential tool calls in a single agent session.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Enters Pilot Deployment at Gigafactory Texas
articles.summary: Tesla confirmed that roughly 100 Optimus Gen 3 humanoid robots are now performing repetitive material-handling and quality-inspection tasks at its Austin Gigafactory. The updated hardware features improved dexterous manipulation with 22-DOF hands and a new proprietary actuator design that increases payload capacity to 25 kg per arm.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics Atlas Now Performs Autonomous Disaster-Site Navigation in DARPA Trials
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics demonstrated its electric Atlas platform navigating unstructured rubble environments autonomously during recent DARPA Robotics Challenge successor trials. The robot used real-time LiDAR-vision fusion and a learned locomotion policy to traverse terrain with 40-degree slopes and partially collapsed structures without human teleoperation.

articles.title: Figure AI Raises $1.5B Series C to Scale Humanoid Robot Manufacturing
articles.summary: Figure AI closed a massive $1.5 billion Series C round led by Microsoft and NVIDIA to build a dedicated humanoid robot factory in South Carolina. The company aims to produce 10,000 Figure 03 units annually by late 2027, targeting warehouse logistics and light manufacturing verticals where labor shortages are most acute.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm GAA Process Node Ahead of Schedule
articles.summary: TSMC announced that its N1.4 gate-all-around process node has entered volume production at its Kaohsiung fab, approximately one quarter ahead of the originally projected timeline. The node delivers a 15% speed improvement and 30% power reduction over N2, with early yields reportedly exceeding expectations and major AI chip customers already in the pipeline.

articles.title: Breakthrough Solid-State Battery from QuantumScape Hits 1,000-Cycle Milestone in EV Testing
articles.summary: QuantumScape reported that its solid-state lithium-metal cells achieved over 1,000 fast-charge cycles while retaining more than 90% capacity in a real-world EV testing partnership with Volkswagen's PowerCo. This milestone addresses the durability concern that has long blocked solid-state commercialization and could enable EVs with 600+ mile range by 2028.
